svg.title: The extensions: how each one flows through the platform
svg.desc: Five lanes. Strategies, trade signals with the AI assistant, notifications and email, portfolio with P&L and performance history, and preferences with currency. Each lane shows the steps from the customer action to the stored result and the services that do the work.
